Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from our security team:

- HIPAA / PHI: The pilot will include synthetic patient records and hashed identifiers only; no direct PHI during the initial 30‑day evaluation. That said, our external legal counsel wants to see HIPAA-ready controls documented if we move to production.
- EU residency: Not required for the pilot, but could be required at production stage depending on business decisions. Please note for roadmaps.
- KMS/HSM: We're primarily interested in whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for dedicated/private deployments and what evidence you can provide for production use. For the pilot, managed keys are fine.
- Evidence packaging: Can you confirm you can provide the following items as part of the prefill: SOC 2 scope page, encryption-at-rest details, RBAC matrix, and a sample of audit log retention policy?

If you can prefill the SIG with the details above, our team will review and come back with any followups. We expect to have a security decision meeting next Tue (4/13).
